x-m-m2-06.material: Batu P(2, 5) a kan faifan haɗin gwiwa shi ne batu mai haɗin x=2 da y=5. Ƙirƙiri layuka y = ax + b da yawa da suke ratsawa ta batu P, sannan ka yi tunani game da ƙarin bayanin da ake buƙata domin a ƙayyade layi guda ɗaya. (Babu zane; za mu yi aiki da daidaito kawai.)
x-m-m2-06.prereq.0: Ma'anar gangare da tsayin y a aikin layi y=ax+b
x-m-m2-06.s.s1.prompt: Daga cikin layuka y = ax + b da suke ratsawa ta batu P(2, 5), ƙirƙiri layuka 3 mabambanta masu gangare a da ya fi 0 da tsayin y b lambar halitta. (Za ka iya rubuta a a matsayin decimal. Misali: 1.5)
x-m-m2-06.s.s1.hint.0: Domin layin ya ratsa ta batu P, dole y ya zama 5 idan x=2. Idan ka saka wannan cikin daidaiton, wace dangantaka za ka samu tsakanin a da b?
x-m-m2-06.s.s1.hint.1: Da farko zaɓi b guda ka tantance a da ya dace da shi, sannan ka duba dukkan sharuɗɗan (tabbatacce, lamba ta halitta).
x-m-m2-06.s.s1.fail.c2: Tsayin y b dole ya zama lambar halitta.
x-m-m2-06.s.s1.fail.c3: Idan ka saka x=2, y ba ya zama 5, don haka ba ya ratsawa ta batu P.
x-m-m2-06.s.s1.explain: Saka x=2, y=5 cikin y=ax+b yana ba da 2a+b=5. Idan b=1, to a=2; idan b=2, to a=1.5; idan b=3, to a=1; idan b=4, to a=0.5. Idan b=5, to a=0, kuma gangaren ba tabbatacciya ba ce. Saboda haka layuka 4 ne kawai gaba ɗaya suka cika sharuɗɗan.
x-m-m2-06.s.s2.prompt: Muna son ƙayyade layi guda ɗaya da ya ratsa ta batu P(2, 5). Zaɓi duk bayanan da za su sa layin ya zama guda ɗaya idan aka ƙara ɗaya daga cikinsu kawai.
x-m-m2-06.s.s2.hint.0: Mayar da kowane bayani zuwa daidaito ko rashin daidaito a cikin a da b.
x-m-m2-06.s.s2.hint.1: Duba ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko haɗa shi da 2a+b=5 yana ƙayyade a da b duka a matsayin ƙimomi guda ɗaya.
x-m-m2-06.s.s2.o.a: Layin yana kuma ratsawa ta batu Q(4, 9)
x-m-m2-06.s.s2.r.a: Wannan zaɓin ya duba ko ƙara wani batu yana ba da ƙarin daidaito guda ɗaya tsakanin a da b.
x-m-m2-06.s.s2.r.b: Kwatanta da layukan da ka ƙirƙira a baya domin ganin ko sharadin “tabbatacciya” yana ƙayyade ƙima guda ɗaya ko yana barin ƙimomi da yawa.
x-m-m2-06.s.s2.o.c: Tsayin y na layin shi ne 3
x-m-m2-06.s.s2.r.c: Wannan zaɓin ya duba ko sanin ƙimar tsayin y yana ƙayyade a a matsayin ƙima guda ɗaya ta hanyar dangantakar da ke tsakanin a da b.
x-m-m2-06.s.s2.o.d: Layin yana kuma ratsawa ta batu R(2, 8)
x-m-m2-06.s.s2.r.d: Ka kwatanta haɗin x na R da na P. Ka yi tunani ko za a iya rubuta layin da ya ratsa batun biyun a sigar y=ax+b.
x-m-m2-06.s.s2.r.e: Wannan zaɓin ya duba ko sanin ƙimar gangare yana ƙayyade b a matsayin ƙima guda ɗaya a cikin 2a+b=5.
x-m-m2-06.s.s2.explain: Sharadin ratsawa ta batu P daidaito guda ɗaya ne kawai, 2a+b=5, saboda haka ana buƙatar ƙarin daidaito guda ɗaya. Amfani da batu Q(4, 9) yana ba da 4a+b=9, kuma daga daidaiton biyun a=2, b=1. Idan tsayin y 3 ne, to b=3 kuma a=1. Idan gangare 2 ce, to a=2 kuma b=1. Sharadin gangare tabbatacciya ba ya ƙayyade ƙimomin a matsayin guda ɗaya. R(2, 8) yana da haɗin x iri ɗaya da P, saboda haka layin da ya ratsa batun biyun yana tsaye wa x-axis daidai kuma ba za a iya rubuta shi a sigar y=ax+b ba.

x-m-m2-02.topic: Lambobin rational da adadi na goma masu maimaituwa
x-m-m2-02.title: Shin 0.999… ya fi 1 ƙanƙanta?
x-m-m2-02.goal: Gyara ra’ayinka na farko game da alaƙar adadin decimal mai maimaituwa 0.999… da 1 bisa ga hujjoji biyu mabambanta.
x-m-m2-02.material: 0.999… adadi ne da 9 ke ci gaba har abada bayan alamar decimal (adadin decimal mai maimaituwa 0.9̇, ana karantawa “sifili da ɗigo tara mai maimaituwa”). Dubi hujjojin ɗaya bayan ɗaya ka ga yadda tunaninka game da alaƙar wannan adadi da 1 yake canzawa.
x-m-m2-02.prereq.0: Ma'ana da rubutun adadin decimal mai maimaituwa
x-m-m2-02.prereq.1: Raba domin rubuta gutsattsari a matsayin decimal
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.prompt: A kowane mataki, ana bayyana ƙarin hujja guda ɗaya. Zaɓi ra'ayin da za ka iya yanke bisa ga hujjojin da ka gani kawo yanzu.
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko ka yi tunani game da ra'ayin da zai yiwu “bisa ga hujjar da kake gani yanzu kawai.”
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta ko zaɓinka na matakin baya ya saɓa da sabuwar hujjar.
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Ba mu yi lissafi ba tukuna. Yayin da kake ƙara 9 ɗaya bayan ɗaya, kamar 0.9, 0.99, 0.999, adadin yana ƙara kusantar 1. Adadin da ake samu idan aka ci gaba da wannan har abada shi ne 0.999….
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: A yanzu, wane zato ne ya fi dacewa game da alaƙar 0.999… da 1?
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Zato kan iya canzawa idan an sami sabuwar hujja. Mu gwada shi da gutsattsari da muka riga muka sani.
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ya ɗan yi ƙasa da 1. Komai yawan 9 da ka ƙara, ba zai kai 1 ba
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Hakika 0.9, 0.99, da 0.999 duk sun fi 1 ƙanƙanta. Amma har yanzu ba mu gwada ko za mu iya ɗaukar “adadin da ke ci gaba har abada” haka nan ba.
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kana iya zato tun farko cewa daidai suke. Dalilin bai da ƙarfi a yanzu, don haka kana buƙatar gwada shi da hujja ta gaba.
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ya fi 1 girma. Tun da 9 ɗin ba za su ƙare ba, daga ƙarshe zai wuce 1
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ka yi tunani cewa guraben bayan alamar decimal ne kawai ke ƙaruwa. Bangaren adadin cikakke ya tsaya a 0.
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ba adadi ba ne, saboda haka ba za a iya kwatanta shi ba
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Yana da ban mamaki domin ba ya ƙarewa, amma decimal mara ƙarewa kamar 1/3 = 0.333… ma adadi ne.
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Raba 1/3 yana ba da 0.333…. Kuma sau 3 na 1/3 shi ne 1. Idan ka ninka kowace lamba ta 0.333… da 3, za ka samu 0.999….
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ta yaya wannan hujja ta canza zato na farkonka?
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Wannan hanya ta dogara da misali guda, 1/3. Mu ga ko wata hanya dabam gaba ɗaya za ta ba da sakamako iri ɗaya.
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ina ganin ya fi kusa da daidai da 1, domin 1/3×3=1
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka yi amfani da hujjar cewa adadi biyu da aka samu ta hanyoyi mabambanta (1 da 0.999…) sun fito daga adadi guda.
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Har yanzu ya fi 1 ƙanƙanta. 0.333… kusancin 1/3 ne, saboda haka ninka shi da 3 zai yi ƙasa kaɗan da 1
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wannan zaɓin yana ɗaukar 0.333… a matsayin “kimantawa.” Idan sakamakon raba 1/3 shi ne 0.333…, sake tunani ko adadi guda ne da aka rubuta ta hanyoyi mabambanta.
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Har yanzu ban tabbatar ba. Ina son in kuma gwada wata hanya
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wannan hali ne na taka-tsantsan, ba a dogara da hujja guda ɗaya kawai ba.
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.1.o.d: 1/3 da 0.333… adadi ne mabambanta, saboda haka ba za a iya amfani da wannan hujja ba
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: 0.333… shi ne abin da ake samu idan an nemo ƙimar 1/3 ta hanyar rabo, don haka ka nemi dalilin da zai sa su zama adadi mabambanta.
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.2.info: A ce x = 0.999…. To 10x = 9.999…. Idan aka cire x daga 10x, za a samu 9.999… − 0.999… = 9, saboda haka 9x = 9 kuma x = 1. (Tun da 9 ɗin suna ci gaba har abada, sassan decimal na adadin biyun daidai suke, don haka idan aka cire su, duk sassan decimal su zama 0.)
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yanzu da ka ga hanyoyin biyu, ta yaya za ka gyara zato na farkonka?
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Duba ko hujja ce, ba ji kawai ba, ta canza ra'ayinka.
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Har yanzu ya fi 1 ƙanƙanta. Komai yawan 9 da ka ƙara, ba zai kai 1 ba
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa 0.9, 0.99, … sun fi 1 ƙanƙanta kai tsaye ga “adadi guda da ke ci gaba har abada.” Kwatanta shi da ƙimar da hujjojin biyun suka nuna.
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Daidai suke. Hanyoyi biyu mabambanta sun ba da sakamako iri ɗaya, saboda haka za a iya yarda da shi
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wannan zaɓin ya gyara ra'ayi ne bisa ga cewa hujjoji biyu masu zaman kansu sun yarda da juna.
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Daidai suke. Ya kamata a ɗauki 0.999… a matsayin adadi guda da ke ci gaba har abada
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wannan zaɓin ya gyara ra'ayi ta hanyar ɗaukarsa a matsayin “adadi guda da aka riga aka ƙayyade” maimakon “tsari.”
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ya fi 1 girma. Cire x daga 10x ya ba da 9, don haka x ya fi girma
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Sake karanta matakan daga 10x − x = 9 zuwa 9x = 9, sannan ka duba yadda aka nemo ƙimar x.
x-m-m2-02.s.s1.reflect: Da farko, tunanin cewa “komai yawan abin da ka ƙara, ba zai kai 1 ba” yana da ƙarfi. Amma yana da ma'ana a gyara ra'ayinka idan misali guda (sau 3 na 1/3) da wata hanya (10x−x) suka nuna sakamako iri ɗaya. Duba ko abin da ya canza ra'ayinka “hujja” ce ko “yanayi.”
x-m-m2-02.s.s2.prompt: Minsu ya ce, “0.999… ya fi 1 ƙanƙanta, domin komai yawan 9 da ka ƙara ba zai taɓa zama 1 ba.” Zaɓi ɗaya daga cikin hanyoyin biyu na sama ka yi ƙoƙarin gamsar da Minsu.
x-m-m2-02.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi ɗaya daga cikin hanyoyin biyu ka nuna wa Minsu lissafin mataki-mataki.
x-m-m2-02.s.s2.hint.1: A jimla ta ƙarshe, ka bayyana a sarari alaƙar da ke tsakanin 0.999… da 1.
x-m-m2-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Kana iya ganin kowane layin lissafi a hanyar da ka zaɓa?
x-m-m2-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka amsa kai tsaye ga maganar Minsu cewa “komai yawan abin da ka ƙara, ba zai taɓa zama 1 ba”?
x-m-m2-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Shin ƙarshen maganarka a sarari yake cewa “daidai” ne ko “ya fi ƙanƙanta”?
x-m-m2-02.s.s2.model.0: Minsu, 1/3 shi ne 0.333…, kuma sau 3 na 1/3 shi ne 1, ko ba haka ba? Sau 3 na 0.333… shi ne 0.999…, saboda haka 0.999… da 1 adadi guda ne.
x-m-m2-02.s.s2.model.1: A ce x = 0.999…. To 10x = 9.999…. Cire x daga 10x ya bar 9, don haka 9x = 9, wanda ke nufin x = 1. Saboda haka 0.999… daidai yake da 1.
x-m-m2-02.s.s2.modelNote.1: Amsa da ke gamsarwa ta amfani da lissafi

x-m-m2-03.title: Nemo kuskure a mafita da aka bincika da x=1
x-m-m2-03.goal: Nemo layin da ba daidai ba a lissafin monomial, sannan ka gyara shi kana bayyana dalilin da ya sa ƙimar da aka yi amfani da ita wajen dubawa ba ta bayyana kuskuren ba.
x-m-m2-03.material: Seojin ya lissafa (−3x²y)² ÷ 6xy² × 2x kuma ya rubuta mafitar da ke ƙasa. Domin dubawa, Seojin ya maye gurbin x=1, y=1, kuma tun da duka asalin furucin da amsar sun ba da 3, Seojin ya yi tunanin “daidai ne.” (Yadda ake karantawa: x² shi ne “x murabba'i”, x⁴ shi ne “x zuwa ƙarfin 4”, 6xy² kuma shi ne “6 sau x sau y murabba'i”; bayan ÷ ana raba da dukan 6xy².)
x-m-m2-03.thinking.2: Nemo ƙimomi da za su bayyana kuskuren da kanka
x-m-m2-03.prereq.1: Maye gurbin haruffa da lambobi domin nemo ƙimar furuci
x-m-m2-03.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda da ba daidai ba a mafitar Seojin ka bincika. (Wataƙila akwai kuskure fiye da ɗaya.)
x-m-m2-03.s.s1.hint.0: Sake lissafa layi ɗaya bayan ɗaya domin ganin ko kowanne layi ya biyo daidai daga sakamakon layin da ya gabata.
x-m-m2-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunani ko za ka iya cewa mafita daidai ce kawai domin ƙimar furucin sun yi daidai, sannan ka sake lissafa kowane layi daga layin da ya gabata.
x-m-m2-03.s.s1.line.4: Maye gurbin x=1, y=1 yana ba da 3 ga asalin furuci da 3 ga 3x⁶, saboda haka mafitar daidai ce.
x-m-m2-03.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ba daidai ba ne. A rabawa, ana rage ma'aunin ƙarfin harafi iri ɗaya, ba a haɗa su ba. x⁴ ÷ x = x³, saboda haka layin ya kamata ya zama (3/2)x³, kuma layi na 4 ya zama 3x⁴. Layi na 5 ma yana da matsala. x=1 yana zama 1 ko da wane irin ƙarfin ka ɗauka, saboda haka ko da ma'aunin ƙarfin bai dace ba, ƙimar da aka samu za ta kasance iri ɗaya.
x-m-m2-03.s.s2.prompt: Nemo (x, y) da za su sa amsar Seojin 3x⁶ ta bambanta da ƙimar asalin furucin, domin a bayyana kuskuren. Yi nau'i-nau'i biyu inda ƙimar x ɗinsu suke da ƙimomin cikakkiya mabambanta. (x da y lambobi ne marasa sifili. Yi lissafin kai tsaye ka duba.)
x-m-m2-03.s.s2.hint.0: Saka ƙimomin cikin asalin furuci ka fara lissafawa, sannan ka saka ƙimomi iri ɗaya cikin 3x⁶ ka kwatanta.
x-m-m2-03.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi tunani dalilin da ya sa x=1 da Seojin ya zaɓa bai dace ba, sannan ka zaɓi x mai wata siffa dabam.
x-m-m2-03.s.s2.ok.c1: x da y ba 0 ba ne.
x-m-m2-03.s.s2.fail.c1: x da y kada su zama 0 (idan sun zama 0, ba za ka iya nemo ƙimar furucin da kake rabawa da shi ba).
x-m-m2-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Ƙimar asalin furucin da ƙimar 3x⁶ sun bambanta, saboda haka an bayyana kuskuren.
x-m-m2-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Da waɗannan ƙimomin, ƙimomin biyu iri ɗaya ne, saboda haka ba a bayyana kuskuren ba.
x-m-m2-03.s.s2.explain: Idan x=2, y=1, asalin furucin shi ne (−12)² ÷ 12 × 4 = 144 ÷ 12 × 4 = 48, amma 3x⁶ = 192, don haka sun bambanta. Idan x=1 ko x=−1, ƙimarsa 1 ce ko da an ɗaga shi zuwa wani ƙarfin, don haka ba za a gano kuskuren ma'aunin ƙarfin ba.
x-m-m2-03.s.s3.prompt: Gyara layi na 3, rubuta amsar ƙarshe daidai, sannan ka bayyana a jimla ɗaya inda aka yi kuskure da dalilinsa.
x-m-m2-03.s.s3.hint.0: Idan ka faɗaɗa x⁴ ÷ x kai tsaye (x×x×x×x ÷ x), nawa ya rage?
x-m-m2-03.s.s3.hint.1: Saka sakamakon layin da aka gyara a layi na gaba, sannan ka ci gaba da lissafi har zuwa amsar ƙarshe.
x-m-m2-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin layin da aka gyara da amsar ƙarshe suna haɗuwa daidai?
x-m-m2-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka ba da dalilin da ya sa dole ne a “rage”, ba kawai cewa ka “haɗa” ba?
x-m-m2-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka saka x=2 da kanka domin ka duba sabuwar amsar?
x-m-m2-03.s.s3.model.0: x⁴ ÷ x ba haɗa ma'aunan ƙarfin ba ne, rage su ake yi, wanda ya ba da x³. Saboda haka (3/2)x³ × 2x = 3x⁴ ita ce amsar ƙarshe.
x-m-m2-03.s.s3.model.1: A rabawa ana rage ma'aunan ƙarfin, don haka x⁴÷x = x^3. Layi na 3 shi ne (3/2)x³ kuma amsar ƙarshe ita ce 3x^4.
x-m-m2-03.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ana karɓar amsar da ta rubuta ma'aunan ƙarfin da ^ ma.

x-m-m2-07.title: Gyara mafitar da ta tantance aikin layi daga jadawali
x-m-m2-07.goal: Koyi cewa idan ana tantance daga jadawali kaɗai ko dangantaka aikin layi ce, dole ne a kuma duba ƙarin x; sannan ka gyara kuskuren mafitar ka yi amfani da shi ga sabon jadawali.
x-m-m2-07.material: Muna son gano daga jadawali ko dangantakar x da y aikin layi ce (y=ax+b, a≠0). Zan karanta jadawalin da kalmomi. Idan x ya zama 1, 2, 3, 5, y zai zama 5, 8, 11, 17 bi da bi. (Jadawali: x | 1 2 3 5 / y | 5 8 11 17)
x-m-m2-07.thinking.2: Amfani da ƙa'idar da aka gyara ga sababbin bayanai
x-m-m2-07.prereq.1: Karanta dangantakar ƙididdiga biyu da aka nuna a jadawali
x-m-m2-07.s.s1.prompt: A ƙasa ga mafitar ɗalibi guda. Zaɓi layi guda da ba daidai ba.
x-m-m2-07.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta tazarar jadawali da kowane layi yake kwatantawa, sannan ka duba a jadawali ko sharuɗɗan waɗannan tazarori iri ɗaya ne.
x-m-m2-07.s.s1.hint.1: Ga kowace tazara, rubuta adadin canjin x da adadin canjin y, sannan ka duba ko sakamakon kowane layi ya fito daga waɗannan bayanan.
x-m-m2-07.s.s1.line.0: Idan x ya ƙaru da 1 daga 1 zuwa 2, y ya ƙaru da 3 daga 5 zuwa 8.
x-m-m2-07.s.s1.line.1: Idan x ya ƙaru da 1 daga 2 zuwa 3, y ya ƙaru da 3 daga 8 zuwa 11.
x-m-m2-07.s.s1.line.2: Idan x ya tashi daga 3 zuwa 5, y ya ƙaru da 6 daga 11 zuwa 17.
x-m-m2-07.s.s1.line.3: Ƙarin y su ne 3, 3, 6, ba su daidaita ba, saboda haka ba aikin layi ba ne.
x-m-m2-07.s.s1.explain: Layi na 4 ba daidai ba ne. A tazara ta uku, x ya ƙaru da 2, ba 1 ba. Idan ƙarin x sun bambanta, kada a kwatanta ƙarin y kaɗai. Idan aka duba ta hanyar (ƙarin y) ÷ (ƙarin x), za a samu 3, 3, 6÷2=3, duka daidai suke, saboda haka aikin layi ne (y=3x+2).
